build_BaseDataset: build a BaseDataset instance with an annotation file, data prefix, and transform pipeline for image classification
get_gt_labels: get all ground-truth labels as a numpy array from an initialized BaseDataset instance
get_cat_ids: get the category id list for a specific data index in the BaseDataset
expanduser_path: expand tilde and user home path constructions in a given file path string
full_init_dataset: fully initialize a BaseDataset by loading the annotation file and generating metainfo from categories
